messages.subject: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body: Please consider these complete packages for the stated requirement. The forecast for part:310020 increased by 20% (fc:310020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Thanks for the good news on the volume increase, that definitely helps us give you a better price! We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. 

But going down to 1500 ppm is a big jump for us and means extra work on the line to make sure everything is perfect. I can offer you €46.50 for the 1500 ppm target with zero chargebacks.

So, our offer is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) - revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for moving to the 1500 ppm target. We understand the extra line workload and that payment terms are fixed in this enquiry, so we have attached three complete packages. You can choose the quality structure that fits your process best.

The producer price index PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96 %.

Our scorecard sc:70140@2026Q3 records 2376 ppm, so a firm quality structure protects both sides.

Could a cheaper casting or machining variant meet the drawing? What is the earliest lead time you can confirm for January, given your holiday shutdown?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) – packages for signature
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for the two alternatives and for taking the index and scorecard data into account. We understand that steady cash flow matters most to you. Our packages cover the full 15900 pieces per year over 12 months from 2027-01-01, which gives your line a predictable, evenly scheduled load for planning and financing.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) – packages for signature
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Thanks for mentioning the 15900 pieces per year, but please send over the actual delivery schedules so we can see this evenly scheduled load. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. 

Our margin and our limits stay internal. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. We're coming down on price for you, but we really need faster payment terms to keep our cash moving. 

I'm setting the 1500 ppm package as our main offer and dropping the price to €45.50. So, we offer a price of €45.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Beside this, we can also consider a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. 

This proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
